description: Affiliate page with a good disclosure that still steers every reader to one lender.
content:
Disclosure: We are paid by the lenders featured on this page.

Find your match

Tell us about your goals and we will match you with a lender. Whether your credit score is 580 or 780, whether you want $3,000 or $30,000, and whatever you plan to use the money for, our featured match is the same: ClearPath Personal Loans.

ClearPath offers 8.99% to 35.99% APR, depending on your credit profile. Check your rate with a soft pull. See your featured match: https://clearpath.example/apply?partner=loanlens

Terms apply.
notes: Hard because the paid-links disclosure is present and 'featured' is mild. Defensible as steering: the page pretends to match on fit but returns the same lender for every score, amount and purpose, so the placement can only be explained by compensation (CFPB Circular 2024-01). Not flagged for FTC-AFFILIATE or a superlative.
